blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The company that provides the technology behind the country’s emergency response system said children should learn how to call 911 not only for their safety, but as well as those close to them. Robert Llaguno, local head of the Next Generation Advanced 911 Philippines (NGA 911), said “teaching young people how to dial the emergency hotline may save precious lives during fires, medical emergencies, severe weather or violent attacks at school or at home.” For Llaguno, “the recent spate of violent incidents in schools in various parts of the country makes it a must for children to know […]...
